## Episode Thesis

This is a macro-focused morning news show. The US-Iran war has no deal in sight, and Trump is signalling impatience. Brent crude is up to about $111 per barrel (roughly +50% since the war began), and US 10-year yields are rising. Asian, US and European markets are weaker. Company coverage is limited to news items: Boliden had a mine rock collapse, Japanese automakers fell and Trump's stock trades were reported. No buy or sell recommendations were made.
